 Dhanteras is considered one of the auspicious festivals in India which will be celebrated on 6th November 2026.
 The festival is associated with wealth, prosperity, good health and happiness. In this auspicious occasion many families consider buying precious metals on this day a symbol of welcoming financial stability and good fortune into their homes.
 On this occasion, devotees worship Goddess Lakshmi, Lord Kubera and Lord Dhanvantari. They also perform special rituals, light diyas and prepare their homes for the festival.
 Dhanteras 2026 Puja Muhurat
 According to the New Delhi Panchang, dhanteras puja muhurat is 6:02 PM to 7:57 PM on 6th November 2026. 
 Dhanteras 2026 Gold and Silver Buying Timing
 According to the Indian Institute of Vedic Science (IIVS), there is no compulsory restriction on making purchases at a particular time during the day. However, many families prefer to purchase gold and silver during this auspicious occasion, the Trayodashi Tithi timings for Dhanteras 2026 are as follows:
 Particulars 
 Date and Time 
 Trayodashi Tithi Begins 
 November 6 at 10:30 AM 
 Trayodashi Tithi Ends 
 November 7 at 10:47 AM 
 Gold Holding Limit in India 2026
 The Income Tax Department has prescribed certain gold jewellery seizure guidelines, but these are not limits on how much gold a person can legally own.
 Category 
 Quantity generally not seized during a search 
 Married woman 
 Up to 500 grams. 
 Unmarried woman 
 Up to 250 grams. 
 Man 
 Up to 100 grams.
